title: Make the normal validation suites reusable
description:
Pull requests, branch builds, and the release workflow execute one maintained definition of the full normal validation suite on their own commit.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The normal CI workflow accepts workflow_call while retaining its pull-request and branch behavior without duplicating Rust, web, MCP, repository-validation, or MSRV job definitions.
- [hard] REQ-02: The shared workflow-verification harness proves a caller receives failure when any required Rust, web, MCP, repository-validation, or exact-MSRV job fails on the called SHA.
- [hard] REQ-03: Existing CI workflow checks and representative local suite commands remain green after the trigger/refactor change.

## Notes

Blast radius: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and workflow-contract tests only; security and publication stay in their dedicated workflows.
